Level 1 · Introduction · Week 8

Loops in Python

A for loop plus pushed-in lines is Scratch's repeat block, written in words.

What you will learn

  • How to repeat lines with for i in range(4):.
  • Why the spaces at the start of a line matter (indentation).
  • The secret rule for drawing any shape with equal sides.
  • How to put a loop inside a loop to make patterns.

The big idea: repeat, in words

Last week your square needed 8 lines. With a loop it needs 3. Compare:

→ 
for i in range(4):
    t.forward(100)
    t.left(90)

Python has no C-shaped block. Instead it uses two clues:

  1. a colon : at the end of the for line, and

  2. 4 spaces at the start of every line inside the loop. This is called indentation.

TipThonny helps you

After a colon, press Return: Thonny pushes the next line in for you. To come back out of the loop, press Delete once.

How many times?

range(4) gives Python four numbers: 0, 1, 2, 3. Python starts counting at 0! What matters is that there are 4 of them, so the loop runs 4 times.

The secret shape rule

To draw a shape and get back to the start, the turtle turns all the way round: 360 degrees. Share that turn between the corners:

turn at each corner = 360 ÷ number of sides

Fill in the missing turns: pentagon (blank to fill in), hexagon (blank to fill in), octagon (blank to fill in).

Folder: week08/ex-polygon-party. The triangle is done. Write a loop for a square (sides of 100) and a loop for a hexagon (sides of 60). Use the shape rule for the turns. Done looks like: an orange triangle, a sky-blue square and a green hexagon, all closed.

A loop inside a loop

A loop can hold another loop. The outer loop picks a color. The inner loop draws a whole square. Then the turtle turns a little and the outer loop goes again.

for color in PALETTE:          # 8 colors: runs 8 times
    t.color(color)
    for side in range(4):       # draws one whole square
        t.forward(100)
        t.left(90)
    t.left(45)                  # 8 x 45 = 360

The inner lines have 8 spaces: 4 for the outer loop and 4 more for the inner loop. How many lines does the turtle draw altogether? (blank to fill in)

Exercise8.3: Square Flower

Folder: week08/ex-square-flower. The starter draws one square. Put the square loop inside a color loop (like the code above) to make 8 squares in 8 colors. Tip: t.speed(0) draws super fast.

New words

Loop
Code that repeats.
for
The Python word that starts a loop: for i in range(4): .
range
Gives the loop its numbers. range(4) means 0, 1, 2, 3: four times.
Indentation
The spaces at the start of a line. They show which lines are inside the loop.
Nested loop
A loop inside another loop.
Off-by-one bug
When a loop runs one time too many or one time too few.

ChallengeCount the taps

Without running it: how many times does this program print tap? (blank to fill in)

for i in range(3):
    for j in range(2):
        print("tap")

Then make a 7-pointed star: 7 lines of 150, turning t.right(360 * 3 / 7) each time (about 154 degrees).
